I have kept bean seed from last season, so I will not buy new packets from the shop. This plot is very small, just behind the house, so my wife and I can manage it ourselves with our hoes. I will put some manure from our goats on it because it costs nothing, but I will not buy fertilizer bags — those are for the maize, and one bag is too much for this small piece anyway. I do not spray chemicals on beans, and we have no water for irrigation — we wait for the rains.
